coverageAssessment.claimedScope: West Bengal Government Land and Land Reforms land-record services, official registration services, state geoportal, and Howrah district administration.

officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official portal advertises plot information, plot-map requests, mouza-map availability, and land-record services; no safe anonymous parcel vector response was verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: NIC West Bengal / Government of West Bengal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official project description identifies eBhuchitra as the state land-records application and says certified ROR, plot information, and plot-map services exist; it does not publish a verified open parcel feature endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of West Bengal state geoportal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official state geoportal advertises geospatial data and a WMS, but no parcel layer, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel response was verified.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Howrah District Administration / Government of West Bengal
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district page provides a district-map link and identifies the district administration; it is not a parcel service.

safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel identifier if publicly exposed

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: No exact-point parcel feature query completed because the official endpoints did not yield a usable anonymous service response; no point-hit or timeout was interpreted as cadastral absence.

blocker: No independently verified anonymous response containing a stable native parcel identity plus complete polygon and CRS. Runtime integration/admission is not qualified.
remainingUncertainty: Debandi's exact local revenue jurisdiction, official viewer JavaScript/configuration, parcel layer schema, CRS, native identity, anonymous query shape, and citywide coverage remain unverified. Connection timeout, map extent uncertainty, or lack of a public feature response is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may re-check the official West Bengal land-record viewer and state geoportal for a public anonymous geometry-only flow, then validate a bounded Debandi-area response and stable native parcel identity before any adapter qualification.
identityPolicy: Retain only a stable native parcel identity with geometry if source evidence proves it; never substitute an internal row number.
